# Navigation spec, 2026-09-23

Designer S3c. Binding on the header, the mega panel, the mobile drawer, the new
shop sheet and the bottom tab bar. Written against the live preview measured on
2026-09-23 at 1440 and 390, `docs/build/DIRECTION.md` sections 4, 5.1, 6.1, 9,
10, and `docs/build/X-IDENTITY-2026-09-22.md` sections 2 to 4. Where this
document overrides one of those, the row says so and gives the reason.

Conventions: px unless stated. "start" and "end" are logical; Arabic is the
default direction and inline-start is the right edge. Every user facing string
is a locale key. No literal Arabic ships in `app/`.

New keys ship in `locales/partials/s3c.ar.json` and `locales/partials/s3c.en.json`
and are mirrored identically into `locales/ar.json` and `locales/en.json`
(`tests/i18n.test.ts` forbids a partial disagreeing with the base).

---

## 0. What is wrong today, measured

Measured live at 1440 on `/ar`, container 1296, nav box 532 wide:

| Item | href it actually resolves to | width |
|---|---|---|
| المنتجات | `/ar/latest-products` | 54 |
| المكملات | `/categories` (no locale prefix) | 79 |
| البروتين | `https://optimalx.com.sa/protein/c9001` (absolute, leaves the preview) | 64 |
| اسأل قبل أن تشتري | `/ar/services` | 121 |
| المزيد | dropdown | 55 |

Five findings, all of them structural rather than cosmetic:

1. **Three overlapping product entries.** المنتجات, المكملات and البروتين are
   three doors into one catalogue. البروتين is one of ten type roots promoted to
   the top level for no stated reason; المكملات is the type list; المنتجات is a
   date sort. A shopper cannot tell from the row which one holds what.
2. **No offers, no brands, no goals on the bar.** The goal axis is the store's
   own positioning ("ما هدفك اليوم؟" is the H1) and it appears nowhere in the
   chrome. `show_goal_nav` is off, so the one panel that carries goals never
   opens.
3. **The row has 31px of slack.** 373 of labels plus four 32px gaps is 501
   against a 532 box. A sixth item cannot be added without changing the row's
   own arithmetic, which is why the hierarchy has never been fixed by adding.
4. **Three link resolutions in one row**: a locale prefixed path, an unprefixed
   path and an absolute origin. The unprefixed `/categories` drops the locale;
   the absolute URL leaves a preview build.
5. **The mega panel traps focus.** `MegaPanel.tsx:46` calls `useDialogFocus` on
   a hover opened, non modal popover. A keyboard visitor who opens it cannot Tab
   past it.

One render budget finding in the same files: `.ox-util__trust--scroller`
(`app/styles/06-ox/_b1-layout.scss:236`) is a horizontal scroller with computed
`position: static` (measured). DIRECTION 10.1's G2 addition requires
`position: relative` on every horizontal scroller.

---

## 1. The hierarchy

One axis of entry per slot, at most six slots, and each slot answers a different
question.

| # | Slot | Question it answers | Destination | Panel |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | تسوق | "what do you sell" | `/categories` | the mega panel (the only one) |
| 2 | العروض | "what is cheaper today" | `/offers` | none |
| 3 | العلامات التجارية | "do you carry my brand" | `/brands` | none |
| 4 | اسأل قبل أن تشتري | "help me choose" | `/services` | none |
| 5 | الأدلة | "explain it to me" | `/blog` | none |
| 6 | المزيد | the shelf | none | dropdown |

### 1.1 Why تسوق and not المنتجات

`ox.nav.shop` is a new key. The label is **تسوق**, 39.7px at 15/600 against
54.1 for المنتجات (measured in the live font), and it is the same word the
mobile tab bar uses for the same content, so the two surfaces are legibly one
thing. DIRECTION 5.1 NavBar named the first item الأهداف; this overrides it,
because the mega now carries both axes and naming it after one of them is what
produced the overlap in section 0. `docs/brand/voice-ksa.md` section 3.7 asks
for a verb the reader does on a control, and تسوق is that verb.

المنتجات, المكملات and البروتين all leave the bar. البروتين is reachable in two
taps from the mega and from `/categories`; it has no claim on a top level slot
that the other nine roots do not have.

### 1.2 Why goals are not a seventh slot

The goals are a column inside the mega, the first region of the mobile shop
sheet, and a new footer column. A seventh bar item for one of the two axes the
mega already shows is the same overlap this document is removing. DIRECTION 5.1
put الأهداف on the bar; overridden here for that reason.

### 1.3 Gates

Only one slot is gated. **العروض renders when
`settings.show_offers_nav !== false` (default on).** "عروض" implies a price
claim, and a store with no live sale must be able to take the word off the bar
without a code change (`docs/build/research/FINAL-claims-source.md` section 3,
invented statistics). العلامات التجارية and الأدلة are never gated at runtime: a
header item that appears after hydration shifts the row, and `/brands` and
`/blog` each own an empty state already (DIRECTION 6.14, 6.13).

### 1.4 The row arithmetic, and the two pinned items

Measured label widths at 15/600 in the live font, plus 18 for a chevron and its
gap:

| Item | label | item |
|---|---|---|
| تسوق | 39.7 | 57.7 |
| العروض | 49.3 | 49.3 |
| العلامات التجارية | 103.9 | 103.9 |
| اسأل قبل أن تشتري | 121.1 | 121.1 |
| الأدلة | 34.5 | 34.5 |
| المزيد | 37.1 | 55.1 |
| **sum** | | **421.6** |

Six items at a 24px row gap cost **541.6**. The nav box today is 532, so the
row's own arithmetic changes with it:

| Property | today | becomes | file |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.ox-mainbar__inner` gap | 48 | **40** | `_b1-layout.scss:312` |
| `.ox-mainbar__search` flex | `0 1 320px`, min 240 | **`0 1 288px`, min 248** | `_b1-layout.scss:360` |
| `.ox-nav__list` gap | `var(--ox-8)` 32 | **`var(--ox-6)` 24** | `_b1-layout.scss:625` |

New nav box at 1440: `1296 - 112 (logo) - 288 (search) - 188 (actions) - 3 x 40
(gaps) = 588`. Cost 541.6, slack 46.4.

At narrower desktops the existing `fitCount` overflow folds the tail, with one
change: **`NavEntry` gains `pin?: true`, set on `shop` and `services`, and
`fitCount` never folds a pinned item.** Without the pin the advisory, which is
the store's whole positioning, is the third thing to disappear.

| viewport | container | nav box | items kept | cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1440 | 1296 | 588 | all six | 541.6 |
| 1280 | 1216 | 508 | five, الأدلة folds | 483.1 |
| 1024 | 960 | 292 | تسوق, اسأل قبل أن تشتري, المزيد | 281.9 |

Below 1024 the whole bar is replaced by the drawer and the tab bar.

## 4. Desktop main bar, 1440

Band `--ox-band-util` for the utility strip, `--ox-band-header` for the main bar
(the live values; DIRECTION 5.1's white `--ox-card` main bar was superseded by
the 2026-09-22 dark header and is not reopened here). The header is in flow, not
sticky (owner call 2026-09-23, `_b1-layout.scss:84`), and stays that way.

```
|<-- 1296 container ------------------------------------------------------->|
| logo 112 |40| nav 588 |40| search 288 |40| actions 188 |
```

| Zone | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Utility strip | 48 tall, `--ox-band-util` | grid `1fr auto 1fr` |
| Main bar | 88 tall, `--ox-band-header` | `--ox-h-bar` at 1024 and up |
| Logo | 112 wide | `Logo width={112} priority` |
| Nav | 588, `flex: 1 1 0` | six items, 44 tall each, 24 gap |
| Search | 288, min 248 | `SallaSearch inline oval height={40}` |
| Actions | 188 | wishlist, account, cart, 28 gap |

### 4.1 Nav item states

| State | Treatment |
|---|---|
| rest | `#c9c7c3`, 15/600, 2px transparent bottom border |
| hover | `--ox-ink-on-dark`, 120ms `--dur-fast`, colour only |
| open | `--ox-ink-on-dark` plus a 2px `--ox-accent` bottom border |
| active route | same as open, plus `aria-current="page"` |
| focus | `outline: 2px solid var(--ox-ink-on-dark)`, offset 4 |

Active route test (replaces the loose `startsWith` at `NavBar.tsx:271`): strip
the locale segment, then match the slot's own route set from section 7.3. A slot
with a dropdown is active when any route in its set matches, so تسوق is
underlined on every catalogue route.

### 4.2 Utility strip, what it keeps

Three zones, nothing else. No announcement duplication, no phone number, no
order tracking (`app/components/product/lib/claims.ts:173`: tracking is a
carrier capability and the setting is empty).

| Zone | Content |
|---|---|
| start | **فرع المدينة المنورة** (`ox.nav.branch`, link to `/branch`, 13/600, `sicon-store` 16) then the WhatsApp affordance labelled `ox.footer.whatsapp` (واتساب), gated on the contact being set |
| centre | the three trust items, unchanged: منتجات أصلية, دفع آمن, شحن داخل المملكة (`UtilityTrust`, `variant="bar"`). Item one links to the merchant's authenticity page when one exists (B18) |
| end | `CountryControl` |

The branch moves here out of المزيد because it is the store's one physical proof
(`FINAL-claims-source.md` section 6) and it was three taps away. The WhatsApp
affordance is relabelled واتساب rather than تواصل معنا so that the footer's
تواصل معنا stays the only anchor with that text (section 9, duplicate link text).

Below 1024 the strip is hidden and `UtilityTrust variant="scroller"` re mounts
under the mobile bar at 40 tall. **Add `position: relative` to
`.ox-util__trust--scroller`** (DIRECTION 10.1, G2 scroller rule; measured
`static` today).

## 5. The mega panel

One panel in the whole header. It hangs from the bottom of the main bar and is
the container's own width.

### 5.1 Positioning

`.ox-mainbar__inner { position: relative }`, `.ox-nav__item--mega { position:
static }`, `.ox-mega { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; inset-block-start:
100%; }`. The panel node stays a DOM child of its `<li>` so Tab order runs
trigger, then panel, then next item; only the containing block moves. Today the
panel is positioned against a 54px `<li>` and a 1296 wide box hung from it
overflows the viewport on the end side.

### 5.2 Grid at 1440

Panel 1296 wide, padding 32, inner 1232, column gap 32.

```
| A  حسب النوع  560 |32| B  حسب الهدف  296 |32| C  promo  312 |
|------------------------ foot row 48 ------------------------|
```

**Column A, حسب النوع, 560.** Heading `ox.nav.by_type`, 13/600 `--ox-fg-3`,
20 tall, 8 below. Then two tracks of 268 with a 24 gap:

| Track 1 (268) | h | Track 2 (268) | h |
|---|---|---|---|
| بروتين | 36 | الفيتامينات والمعادن | 36 |
| واي بروتين (indent 16, 13/400) | 32 | الكولاجين والجمال | 36 |
| واي بروتين ايزوليت | 32 | الصحة اليومية | 36 |
| بروتين كازين | 32 | سناكات وبروتين بار | 36 |
| بروتين نباتي | 32 | الإكسسوارات | 36 |
| ماس جينر | 32 | 1px `--ox-bd` rule, 12 above and below | 25 |
| كرياتين | 36 | الحزم | 36 |
| ما قبل التمرين | 36 | المكتبة الرقمية | 36 |
| الأحماض الأمينية | 36 | بطاقات الهدايا | 36 |
| أوميغا 3 والزيوت | 36 | | |
| **track** | **340** | **track** | **313** |

Column A height 20 + 8 + 340 = **368**.

Root rows: 15/600 `--ox-ink`, hover `--ox-accent-dark`, focus `--ox-focus-ring`
offset 2. Child rows: 13/400 `--ox-fg-3`, hover `--ox-ink`.

**الاستشارات والخدمات is not in this column.** Slot 4 owns `/services`; two
anchors with two different labels pointing at two different pages about one
thing is the duplicate entry defect this document exists to remove.

**Column B, حسب الهدف, 296.** Heading `ox.nav.by_goal`, 20 plus 8. Then a 2 by 3
grid of goal tiles, 142 x 92, gap 12, grid height 300. Column height **328**.

Goal tile: sprite icon 24 (one accent element per symbol, BUILD 3.5), label
14/700 `--ox-fg` clamped to one line, `--ox-card` fill, 1px `--ox-bd`, radius
`--ox-r-3` (12). Hover: border `--ox-bd-2` and fill `--ox-fill`. **No lift, no
shadow, no scale** (BUILD 3.4, DIRECTION 5 card default). The six goals come
from `MENU.goals` in taxonomy order: الطاقة, الصحة العامة, الأداء, التعافي,
الشعر والبشرة, الوزن المثالي.

**Column C, the promoted tile, 312.** One `<a>`, rendered only when both
`settings.mega_promo_url` and `settings.mega_promo_image` are non empty strings.

| Row | Size |
|---|---|
| image on `--ox-plate`, `object-fit: cover`, explicit `width`/`height` attributes | 312 x 226 |
| gap | 12 |
| eyebrow, `ox.nav.promo_label`, 13/600 `--ox-fg-3` | 18 |
| gap | 4 |
| title, `settings.mega_promo_title`, 18/700 `--ox-fg`, clamp 2 | 52 |
| gap | 12 |
| link row, `settings.mega_promo_line` or `ox.common.view_all`, 15/600 `--ox-accent-dark` with a 16 chevron that mirrors | 44 |
| **total** | **368** |

`--ox-accent-dark` (#D03709) on `--ox-card` measures 4.96:1. `--ox-accent`
(#F54915) is 3.59:1 and never carries text.

When the promo is absent the panel is two columns, `760 | 32 | 440`: column A
keeps two 368 tracks, column B's goal grid goes 2 up at 214 x 92. Below 1280 the
promo column is hidden by media query for the same reason.

**Foot row**, full panel width, 16 above, 1px `--ox-bd` top rule, 48 tall: two
links at the start, **كل الأنواع** to `/categories` and **كل العلامات التجارية**
to `/brands`, 15/600, 24 apart.

Panel height 32 + 368 + 16 + 1 + 48 + 32 = **497**. Ship `min-block-size: 480px`,
`block-size: auto`, `max-block-size: calc(100dvh - 200px)`, `overflow-y: auto`.

### 5.3 The panel is not an angled surface

X-IDENTITY section 3.3, one angled gesture per component block: the header's one
gesture is the **active tab indicator's notch** on mobile and the **2px accent
underline** on desktop, which is axis aligned and carries no angle. The mega
panel, its tiles, its badges and its foot row are all straight. No `clip-path` in
the header outside `.ox-tab.is-active::after`.

### 5.4 Motion

Entrance `ox-pop-in`: `opacity 0 to 1` plus `translateY(-4px) to 0`,
`--dur-base` 180ms `--ease-out`. Exit: unmount, no animation (an entrance with an
instant exit satisfies "every entrance has a shorter exit"). Under
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the entrance is `ox-fade-in --dur-fast`, which
the stylesheet already declares. Compositor only properties; nothing else in the
header animates, and colour never transitions except the 120ms nav item hover,
which is a colour on a text node with no layer cost.

### 5.5 Keyboard and screen reader

The panel is a **disclosure**, not a menu and not a dialog. WAI ARIA's own site
navigation guidance is followed rather than the menubar pattern, because every
item in it is a link.

| Behaviour | Rule |
|---|---|
| Trigger markup | `<a href="/{locale}/categories" aria-expanded aria-controls={panelId} id={triggerId}>` plus the chevron. It keeps a real href so a no JS or keyboard visitor still reaches the index |
| Panel markup | `<div id={panelId} aria-labelledby={triggerId}>` containing three `<section>`s, each opened by a visible `<h3 class="ox-mega__heading">`. **Remove `role="group"` and `tabIndex={-1}`** |
| Opening | pointer enter after 120ms intent, or `focus` on the trigger. Opening **never moves focus** |
| Closing | pointer leaves item and panel for 200ms; `Escape` (closes and returns focus to the trigger); `focusout` on the `<li>` whose `relatedTarget` is outside it |
| Focus trap | **none.** Remove `useDialogFocus(panelRef, true)` at `MegaPanel.tsx:46`. A hover opened non modal popover that traps focus strands a keyboard visitor |
| Tab order | trigger, then column A rows in DOM order, then B, then C, then the foot row, then the next nav item. Guaranteed by keeping the panel inside its `<li>` |
| Escape listener | attached while open only, and `event.stopPropagation()` is not used, so the drawer's own Escape still works |
| Announcement | the three `<h3>`s give a screen reader the panel's structure; the lists are real `<ul>` and `<li>` |

Every focusable element in the header carries `--ox-focus-ring` and none of them
sits on a `clip-path` selector (X-IDENTITY section 3.4, `focus-clipped`).

## 6. Mobile drawer, 390

The drawer is the **site map**. The sheet in section 7.1 is the **catalogue**.
They share one component, `ShopTree`, so the two surfaces can never become two
different site maps again (the defect `MobileDrawer.tsx:113` already describes).

Panel `min(86vw, 360px)` equals 335 at 390, full height, `--ox-card`, slides from
the inline start, backdrop flat `rgba(14,16,20,0.5)` with **no `backdrop-filter`**,
unmounted when closed. Focus trapped, `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` (this one
is modal and the trap is correct).

### 6.1 Rows, top to bottom

| Level | Row | h | Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| head | logo 40 and close 44 | 64 | |
| 0 | **حسب النوع** `ox.nav.by_type` | 48 | accordion |
| 1 | the 10 type roots, 15/600, indent 16 | 44 each | link, protein is itself an accordion |
| 2 | protein's 5 children, 13/400, indent 32 | 44 each | link |
| 1 | rule, then the 3 utility categories | 44 each | link |
| 0 | **حسب الهدف** `ox.nav.by_goal` | 48 | accordion |
| 1 | the 6 goals, icon 24 plus 15/600, indent 16 | 48 each | link |
| 0 | العروض | 48 | link, same gate as the bar |
| 0 | العلامات التجارية | 48 | link |
| 0 | اسأل قبل أن تشتري | 48 | link |
| 0 | الأدلة | 48 | link |
| 0 | **المزيد** `ox.nav.more` | 48 | accordion |
| 1 | فرع المدينة المنورة, عن اوبتيمال اكس, تواصل معنا | 44 each | link |
| 0 | rule on `--ox-fill`, then حسابي and المفضلة, icon 24 | 48 each | link |
| foot | `LocalizationButton` 48, the delivery promise line when set, WhatsApp and phone rows 44 | | |

**Maximum depth is three levels and only one branch reaches it** (protein's
children). One group open at a time: opening a level 0 accordion closes the
others, which keeps the panel under two screens.

### 6.2 Accordion behaviour

`<button aria-expanded>` on the group row, chevron `sicon-keyboard_arrow_down`
rotating 180 degrees at `--dur-base --ease-out`, panel height animated with
`grid-template-rows` (the single written exception in X-IDENTITY section 5).
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the chevron and the panel both drop their
transition, which `_b1-layout.scss` already does.

## 7. Bottom tab bar

### 7.1 التصنيفات becomes تسوق, and it opens a sheet

**Yes.** Two reasons, both structural:

1. التصنيفات names a data structure; تسوق names the action, and it is the same
   word as desktop slot 1, so the two surfaces are one thing.
2. The tab opens the **side drawer scrolled to a group** today
   (`BottomTabBar.tsx:111` calls `openMobileDrawer('categories')`). That makes
   one control do two jobs: the site map and the catalogue. A shopper who wants a
   category gets a list that also holds the language switch, the phone number and
   the account rows. The new control opens a **full height sheet that holds the
   catalogue and nothing else**, and the drawer keeps the site map on the menu
   button in the header.

### 7.1.1 The shop sheet, 390

`position: fixed; inset: 0; block-size: 100dvh;` (not `100vh`, for the iOS URL
bar), `--ox-card`, `overflow-y: auto`, `overscroll-behavior: contain`,
`role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={ox.nav.shop_sheet_label}`, focus
trapped, unmounted when closed, no backdrop (it is full height), no
`backdrop-filter`. Entrance `translateY(100%) to 0` at `--dur-slow --ease-out`;
exit `--dur-base --ease-in`; under reduced motion an opacity cross fade.

Gutter 16, content 358.

| Region | Content | h |
|---|---|---|

Two icon changes, both with a measured reason:

- **The cart tab stops using `sicon-shopping-bag`.** `MainBar.tsx:119` records

  and the mobile header already use, so one glyph serves all three.
- **تسوق uses `sicon-grid` (U+EC76)**, verified present in the loaded face on

Slot 3 opens the search sheet rather than navigating to `/search`, which is
DIRECTION 5.1's own BottomTabBar wording: navigating lands the shopper on an
empty results page.

Strip the locale segment first: `stripLocale('/ar/offers')` equals `/offers`.
The current `path.includes(match)` test at `BottomTabBar.tsx:91` matches `/cart`
inside `/account/cart-anything`; replace it.

| Tab | Matches |

| الرئيسية | `/` exactly |
| تسوق | `/categories`, `/offers`, `/latest-products`, `/most-sales-products`, `/brands`, `/brands/*`, `/{slug}/c{id}`, `/{slug}/brand-{id}`, `/{slug}/tag-{id}`, `/{slug}/p{id}`, `/tags/*` |
| البحث | `/search` |

The "none" row is deliberate and is the point of the table: a tab bar that always

## 8. One link resolution rule

Every nav destination in the theme is a **locale prefixed relative path**.

1. `resolveNavHref` returns the engine menu URL only after `menuSegments()` has
   reduced it to a path; the origin is dropped. The absolute
   `https://optimalx.com.sa/protein/c9001` rendered in the bar today leaves a
   preview build.
2. Paths are prefixed with the active locale segment by the engine `Link`. A raw
   `<a href>` in `NavBar.tsx` (the mega trigger) must prefix by hand, which is
   why `/categories` currently drops the locale.
3. A slug with no live category still falls back to `/search?q=<label>`
   (PLAN-final C15). That stays.

---

## 9. The SEO reading

| Requirement | How it is met |
|---|---|
| Every root type reachable in two taps | desktop: تسوق then the row. Mobile: the تسوق tab then the tile |
| Every goal reachable in two taps | same, column B and the sheet's first region |
| Protein's 5 children | three taps, by design (section 7.1.1), and they are in the drawer's accordion and on the protein listing's chip row |
| Crawlable links in SSR HTML | the mega panel and the sheet mount on interaction, so their anchors are **not** in the served HTML. The crawl surface is `/categories`, which already renders all 25 nodes as real `<a>` in SSR (verified 2026-09-23: 10 type roots, 5 protein children, 4 utility, 6 goals). Slot 1's own `href` is `/categories`, so the crawler follows the trigger into the index |
| Goals in SSR from every route | **the footer gains a fifth column, `ox.nav.by_goal`, with the six goal links.** Today the footer carries four type links and no goal, so the goal axis exists in SSR on `/categories` alone |
| No duplicate link text | the rule is: **no two anchors on one route carry the same visible text pointing at different URLs.** Two anchors sharing a URL with different text is allowed and is what a mega panel is. One live breach on `/categories` today: تواصل معنا points at `wa.me/...` in the utility strip and at `/ar/contact` in the footer. Fixed in 4.2 by relabelling the strip's affordance واتساب |
| One h1 per route | unchanged: the header has none, the logo carries the store name in `alt` (DIRECTION 9.2) |
| Nav landmarks | three named: `ox.nav.main_label` on the desktop nav, `ox.nav.quick_label` on the tab bar, `ox.nav.drawer_label` on the drawer. The sheet is a dialog, not a landmark |

---

## 10. Render budget

Asserted from source and measured in Chromium at 390 and 1440 on 2026-09-23. No
device eviction test was possible here; G4 still measures the built output.

| Rule | State after this spec |
|---|---|
| Glows are radial gradients, never `filter: blur()` | no `filter` anywhere in the header (grep clean across `app/styles/06-ox/`) |
| `backdrop-filter` rationed | **zero** backdrop roots. The drawer backdrop is a flat `rgba(14,16,20,0.5)`; the sheet has none; the header band is opaque |
| No permanent promotion | no `will-change`, no `translateZ(0)`, no `transform-gpu` (grep clean) |
| No `filter` on an ancestor of `background-clip: text` | `background-clip: text` is not used |
| No fixed full viewport decoration | the only fixed full viewport boxes are the drawer backdrop and the sheet, both mounted only while open |
| Fixed panels stay inside the viewport | drawer and sheet are conditionally rendered; the drawer's fixed outer box is pinned with `overflow: hidden` and the inner panel translates; the sheet uses `100dvh` |
| Every horizontal scroller `position: relative` | **one fix required**: `.ox-util__trust--scroller` is `static` (measured). Add `position: relative` |
| Visually hidden text is clip rect | `.ox-sr-only` only; no `-9999px` in the header |
| `html` and `body` backgrounds match the ground | both `#FFFFFF`, the route ground (measured) |
| Fixed layer cost at rest, 390 | tab bar 390 x 56 at 3x, about 0.8 MB. The header is in flow and costs nothing |
| Transient | the sheet's entrance promotes one 390 x 844 layer for 280ms, about 3.9 MB at 3x, released on settle; it never coexists with the drawer or the tab bar |
| Document width | 390 at 390 (measured `scrollWidth` equals 390), 1427 at 1427 |

## Addendum, 2026-09-24 (S9a-V3), the header feature audit

Owner instruction, quoted: "audit the options and features in it, if
anything can't be integrated in Shopify, delete it. we are about to go
absolutely deployment ready in a short time, we cannot handle risks, we
would be able to enhance and add them later."

Every affordance the header (desktop and mobile) and the bottom tab bar
carry, checked against Shopify's native storefront:

| Affordance | Surface | Shopify native? | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search | Main bar, mobile header, tab bar | yes | keep |
| Cart | Main bar, mobile header, tab bar | yes | keep |
| Account: profile, orders, addresses | `salla-user-menu` dropdown | yes | keep |
| Account: login / logout | `salla-user-menu`, `SallaLoginModal` | yes | keep |
| Account: notifications | `salla-user-menu` dropdown (opaque); `/account/notifications` route | no | flagged, not pruned, see note below |
| Account: wallet / loyalty points | `salla-user-menu` dropdown (opaque); `/account/wallet` route | no | flagged, not pruned, see note below |
| Account: ratings | `salla-user-menu` dropdown (opaque) | partial (Shopify reviews are app-based, not an account tab) | flagged, not pruned, see note below |
| **Wishlist** | header heart (desktop), drawer row, PDP gallery heart, product card heart | **no** | **deleted**: header link (`MainBar.tsx`), drawer row (`MobileDrawer.tsx`), PDP gallery heart (`PdpGallery.tsx`). The product card heart is a separate builder's file (V4, out of this batch's edit list per a mid-batch scope change) and is not touched here. `BuyZone/WishlistShare.tsx` carries a third wishlist button but is imported nowhere in the app (`grep` confirms), dead code, left as found, flagged for a follow-up cleanup rather than edited without a live reason to |
| Country / language selector | `CountryControl`, `LocalizationButton` | yes (Shopify markets/language picker) | keep |
| Trust items (authentic / secure payment / shipping) | `UtilityTrust` | generic content, no platform dependency | keep |
| Branch link | utility bar, drawer's المزيد | generic store-location page | keep |
| WhatsApp link | utility bar, drawer foot | generic contact channel | keep |
| Shop mega panel / catalogue nav | `NavBar`, `MegaPanel`, `ShopSheet` | yes (collection navigation) | keep |
| Bottom tab bar (home / shop / search / cart / account) | `BottomTabBar` | yes, each slot individually | keep (already carried no wishlist tab before this batch) |

**Why the `salla-user-menu` sub-entries are flagged rather than pruned.**
`salla-user-menu`'s full prop surface is `avatarOnly, inline,
relativeDropdown, showHeader, showTrigger` (`docs/build/engine-surface.md`
§9.2), no prop selects or hides an individual dropdown entry, and the
brief's own fallback for that case is to replace the whole control with a
plain account link plus a hand-built login/register pair. Investigated
before deciding against it this batch, for three reasons: (1) this offline
preview carries no signed-in session (`SallaLoginModal` mounts globally,
`eventTriggered: true`, confirming the store always renders signed-out
here), so there is no verified evidence of what the dropdown actually
contains, the store's own settings may already have notifications, wallet
or loyalty switched off, in which case there is nothing to prune; (2) the
login modal is `eventTriggered` (`docs/build/engine-surface.md` §15.3), not
reachable from a plain `href`, this batch found no documented SDK event
name to open it, so a hand-built login trigger could not be verified
working; replacing Salla's own session/login/logout path with an unverified
one is exactly the kind of risk the owner's instruction asks this batch to
avoid, not add. (3) The component already delivers the Shopify-parity set
the owner's own instruction asks to keep (profile, orders, addresses, login,
logout). Recommendation, not actioned here: get one screenshot of a real
signed-in account dropdown (or the store's own loyalty/wallet/notification
settings) before spending the risk of a rebuild on entries that may not even
be showing.

Files touched for the deletions: `app/components/layout/Header/MainBar.tsx`,
`app/components/layout/Header/MobileDrawer.tsx`,
`app/components/product/BuyZone/PdpGallery.tsx`,
`app/styles/06-ox/_b1-layout.scss` (comments only, no rule depended on the
removed markup). Full working notes in `docs/build/progress/S9a-V3.md`.

## Addendum, 2026-09-24 (S9g), the country selector is removed; a plain language switch replaces it

Owner instruction, quoted: "arabic and english language switch can be
confusing, as the other would only see the country; it should be obvious to
be a language switch, showing العربية in English, and EN in the Arabic
version."

This **supersedes** the "Country / language selector" row of the 2026-09-24
header feature audit above (`CountryControl`, `LocalizationButton`, "keep").
That row was right that Shopify has a native equivalent; it was wrong about
what this store needed: a country/currency picker reads as a market switch,
not a language switch, on a single-market, SAR-only store, the exact
confusion the owner's instruction names.

**Removed**, from both the utility bar (desktop) and the drawer's foot
(mobile): the country control (`CountryControl.tsx`, the store's own country
name plus a chevron, opening Salla's localisation modal) and the
language-and-currency button (`LocalizationButton.tsx`, same modal). Neither
component file is deleted, both stay for the one caller each still has
(`CountryControl` reads `useLocalizationEnabled` from
`LocalizationButton.tsx`; `LocalizationButton.tsx`'s own `LocalizationModal`
is still mounted once by `OptimalXLayout`, since a modal with nothing left to
open it is simply inert, not broken), but neither renders from the header or
the drawer any more, and no code path opens the modal any longer.

**Added**, in the same two spots: one plain link, `otherLocaleLink`
(`app/components/layout/navLinks.ts`), rendered by `UtilityBar.tsx`
(`.ox-util__lang`, a quiet 44px-tall text link, no icon, no chevron, never a
button) and by `MobileDrawer.tsx` (`.ox-drawer__localize.ox-localize`, the
existing 44px drawer-foot row shape, with the globe glyph the old button
carried). Both are raw `<a>` elements, not the engine `Link`, the same
precedent `navLinks.ts` already documents for the mega panel's shop trigger:
`Link`'s `BaseLinkProps` carries no `lang`/`hrefLang`, and a real,
hand-prefixed `href` still reaches the other language with no JS (the
engine's own client-nav interception, `interceptLinks: true` by default,
still picks it up for same-origin clicks).

The link switches to the SAME page under the other language: `lang`,
`hrefLang` and the visible text are all the TARGET language's own, "EN" on
an Arabic page, "العربية" on an English one, and the accessible name is
phrased in the CURRENT page's language (`ox.header.switch_language_en` /
`_ar`, `locales/partials/s9g.*.json`). It renders only when
`store.settings.is_multilingual` is true and the store's own language list
(`useTwilight().settings.languages`) carries the other locale, the gate that
leaves the live store, English disabled, with no link at all (confirmed
against the fixture in `docs/live-theme/fixtures/fixture-home.html`:
`is_multilingual: false`, one language, `AR`).

**No country selector anywhere, confirmed.** `grep -rn "CountryControl\|LocalizationButton\|LocalizationModal" app` finds only the three files above importing/exporting them, none of it reachable from a click any more; the currency stays SAR (`currencies_enabled` is false on the live store today, and this batch adds no currency control to replace it).

Files touched: `app/components/layout/Header/UtilityBar.tsx`,
`app/components/layout/Header/MobileDrawer.tsx`,
`app/components/layout/navLinks.ts` (the `otherLocaleLink` helper),
`app/styles/06-ox/_b1-layout.scss` (`.ox-util__lang` added; the localize
section comment updated), `locales/partials/s9g.ar.json`,
`locales/partials/s9g.en.json`, `tests/layout/linkResolution.test.ts`,
`tests/layout/UtilityBar.test.tsx` (new), `tests/layout/MobileDrawer.test.tsx`.
Full working notes in `docs/build/progress/S9g.md`.
